name: Zakhar Pashkin
title: Senior ML Engineer
specialisms: Computer Vision, Document AI & Agentic Systems
summary: Senior ML Engineer with 8+ years developing computer vision and applied ML from research through deployment. Shipped food-recognition and OCR workflows at Carb Manager and built financial-document recognition at CFT. Currently in Riverstart's R&D ML team, developing document AI and evaluating engineering-analysis methods. Also maintain an AI nutrition service and publish model-profiling and optimization tools.

bullets: Own R&D implementation and evaluation of an on-premises document assistant that extracts case facts and reconciles records for specialist review. Separate deterministic checks from model explanations and link outputs to source documents.

Build evaluation workflows for scan registration against CAD references, CAD projection and drawing comparison, using controlled geometry to check projected and hidden edges. Develop construction-document analysis that links extracted quantities to source pages.
Build repeatable evaluation and release workflows for LLM services with versioned artifacts, regression checks, observability and rollback.

experience.role: ML / Computer Vision Engineer - Independent Projects
bullets: Developed skin-analysis CV pipelines for Dermaself, covering guided capture, facial regions, pore and wrinkle segmentation, model evaluation and mobile/API integration with PyTorch, OpenMMLab, ONNX and Flutter.
Resolved model-asset and runtime differences between Cloud Run and GPU deployments, restoring matching wrinkle-segmentation outputs in regression comparisons and profiling remaining bottlenecks.
Built and shipped food-recognition and nutrition-label workflows across cloud, iOS and Android for Carb Manager, a nutrition product serving millions of customers.

Owned data preparation, model development and evaluation through APIs, mobile export and runtime profiling. Combined detection, OCR and table parsing into structured nutrition data, working with mobile, backend and product teams on quality and failure handling.
Built core detection, segmentation and OCR models for CFT's financial-document recognition platform using PyTorch and OpenMMLab.

Optimized meter-recognition models for mobile use through architecture changes, quantization and runtime profiling. Built active-learning and assisted-annotation workflows to reduce manual labeling, and mentored engineers on data quality and evaluation.
Built ML learning software, coordinated remote contributors and mentored applied CV projects from dataset definition through evaluation and working demos.
